question: A dealer bought an article at 10% discount on its marked price, and sold it at a price which was 15% above the marked price. The gain per cent (correct to the nearest integer) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**CP ∶ SP = (100 - D%) ∶ (100 + P%)

⇒ CP ∶ SP = (100 - 10) ∶ (100 + 15) = 18 ∶ 23

Profit = 23 - 18 = 5 units

Profit % = (5/18) × 100 ≈ 28%

**∴ The required profit is 28%.**
